description.value: 4 Seasons Chaat House is a casual Indian street-food restaurant in New Westminster specializing in authentic chaats, samosas, pav bhaji, and clay-oven tandoori dishes. The restaurant offers both indoor and outdoor seating in a lively atmosphere with Hindi music and a menu spanning North and South Indian cuisine. Reviewers consistently praise the generous portions, fresh ingredients, and welcoming owner.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business name, phone number (+1 604-515-1070), and street address (420 6th Street) match OSM, but the website and postal code V3L 3B2 clearly place the restaurant in New Westminster, not North Vancouver as the OSM community tag states — the coordinates (49.21°N, 122.92°W) also align with New Westminster, not North Vancouver. Takeout/delivery is confirmed via the website's 'Order Online' feature and the contact page stating 'delivery or pickup.' Several vegetarian items are explicitly flagged on the menu, including Malai Soya Chaap described as 'a flavorful vegetarian experience,' but no information on bike parking, water refill, or most optional amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM community tag is 'North Vancouver' but the website explicitly states New Westminster and the postal code V3L 3B2 confirms this. The coordinates (49.2107°N, 122.9175°W) are consistent with New Westminster, not North Vancouver. Record likely mis-assigned to the wrong community in the OSM dataset.
